CALL TO ORDER

At 6:10 PM, Vice Chair Batts called the meeting to order.

ROLL CALL

Commissioners Present: Butler, De Leon, Gillette, Koll, Lissette Flores, McNeill, Montgomery,
Samé-Weil, Schultz, Shaw-Malone, Batts, Covington

Commissioners Absent: Lara

Also present: Tony Viramontes, Equity and Community Engagement Program Specialist,
Alyssa Campos, City Clerk Specialist.

Commissioner Flores and Commissioner Lara are excused from the meeting.

CHAIR REMARKS

Commissioner Butler provided a land acknowledgment.

 Vice Chair Batts provided opening remarks.

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  25-54257  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Equity and Human Relations
  Commission meeting of Wednesday, January 15, 2025.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Schultz, seconded by Commissioner
  Montgomery, to approve recommendation. The motion carried by the
  following vote:

  Yes:  12 Butler, De Leon, Gillette, Koll, Lissette Flores, McNeill, Montgomery,
  Samé-Weil, Schultz, Shaw-Malone, Batts, Covington
  No:  0 None
  Recused: 0 None

2.  25-54258  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation from Better World Group
  regarding Riverpark Coalition’s efforts to save the last parcels of open space in
  Western Long Beach.

  This Agenda Item was withdrawn.

3.  25-54259  Recommendation to discuss and, if appropriate, approve a letter from the BIPOC
  Preservation Ad Hoc Committee to City Council, outlining recommendations for the
  conservation of Long Beach art and landmarks.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Butler, seconded by Chair Covington,
  to approve recommendation, as amended, that the BIPOC Preservation Ad
  Hoc Committee complete the following: [1] redraft the letter with the
  recommendations addressed in this item’s discussion; [2] schedule a
  meeting with Arts Council for Long Beach and Department of Public Works to
  review the redrafted letter ask clarifying questions brought up in the item’s
  discussion; and [3] bring back the redrafted letter to the Commission for
  approval to forward to Mayor and City Council at a future Equity and Human
  Relations Commission meeting. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  12 Butler, De Leon, Gillette, Koll, Lissette Flores, McNeill, Montgomery,
  Samé-Weil, Schultz, Shaw-Malone, Batts, Covington
